transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I've been having these episodes where I eat a really huge amount of food all at once. It feels like I completely lose control and just can't stop myself from eating.
After these episodes of overeating, do you engage in any behaviors to prevent weight gain, such as self-induced vomiting, excessive exercise, or the misuse of laxatives?
No, I don't do any of those things to try to make up for it. I've never made myself throw up, used laxatives, or tried to exercise excessively after an episode.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Binge-Eating Disorder, Bulimia Nervosa]. Based on the patient's explicit denial of compensatory behaviors (such as self-induced vomiting, laxative misuse, or excessive exercise), Bulimia Nervosa is excluded, leaving Binge-Eating Disorder as the primary candidate.
